title: Method for preparing adsorbent by waste boric sludge sulfonic acid group graft modification
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing an adsorbent by waste boric sludge sulfonic acid group graft modification, wherein the method comprises the steps: mixing boric sludge with diluted hydrochloric acid after size mixing, stirring, heating, cooling to room temperature, separating filter residues, washing to neutrality, grinding into boric sludge acid leaching powder, mixing with 3-glycidoxypropyltrimethoxysilane, dissolving, heating, stirring, refluxing, and filtering, washing and drying filter residues to obtain dried powder; and mixing and dissolving with branched chain polyethyleneimine, heating, stirring and refluxing, washing filter residues, carrying out neutral drying, dissolving and uniformly mixing with sodium 2-bromoethanesulfonate in proportion, stirring, heating andrefluxing, adding a corresponding amount of dissolved sodium hydroxide, stirring, refluxing, filtering the filter residues, cleaning to be neutral, and carrying out vacuum drying, so as to obtain thegroup modified boric sludge adsorbent. According to the process, recycling of the solid waste boron mud is achieved, the adsorbent low in cost is prepared through specific material design and processoptimization, and magnesium resources in the adsorbent are recycled; the boric sludge modified by sulfonic acid has a more excellent adsorption effect on positively charged pollutants.
